FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_FloatGlass_DiamondScoringCleave
(*
 =========================================================================================
  LUMINA ADVANCED INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION SYSTEMS - CYBER-PHYSICAL CONTROL DIVISION
  APPLICATION     : CONTINUOUS SODA-LIME PLATE GLASS FLOAT PRODUCTION LINE
  SUBSYSTEM       : COLD-END TRANSVERSE & LONGITUDINAL DIAMOND SCORING BRIDGE
  ALGORITHM CORE  : DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (KALMAN ESTIMATOR),
                    CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFINED DEPTH PROFILE,
                    TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) FORCE & ACOUSTIC CLEAVE VOTING,
                    GRIFFITH-IRWIN LINEAR ELASTIC FRACTURE MECHANICS (LEFM) ADAPTATION.
 =========================================================================================
*)
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable                 : BOOL;     (* System Master Execution Permissive [TRUE=Active, FALSE=Safe Halt] *)
    bEmergencyStop          : BOOL;     (* Hardwired Dual-Channel Category 4 / SIL 3 Safety Relay [TRUE=Normal, FALSE=Trip] *)
    rRibbonSpeed_mpmin      : LREAL;    (* Float Glass Lehr Ribbon Velocity [m/min] Range: 1.0 .. 35.0 *)
    rGlassThickness_um      : LREAL;    (* Calibrated Laser Triangulation Ribbon Caliper [um] Range: 1500.0 .. 25000.0 *)
    rGlassTemp_degC         : LREAL;    (* Non-Contact Narrow-Band Infrared Pyrometer Reading [deg C] Range: 20.0 .. 180.0 *)
    rNormalForce_ChA_N      : LREAL;    (* Dynamic Piezoelectric Load Cell Transducer A [N] Range: 0.0 .. 500.0 *)
    rNormalForce_ChB_N      : LREAL;    (* Dynamic Piezoelectric Load Cell Transducer B [N] Range: 0.0 .. 500.0 *)
    rNormalForce_ChC_N      : LREAL;    (* Dynamic Piezoelectric Load Cell Transducer C [N] Range: 0.0 .. 500.0 *)
    rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz : LREAL;  (* High-Frequency Resonant Acoustic Emission Cleave Sensor A [kHz] Range: 10.0 .. 500.0 *)
    rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz : LREAL;  (* High-Frequency Resonant Acoustic Emission Cleave Sensor B [kHz] Range: 10.0 .. 500.0 *)
    rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz : LREAL;  (* High-Frequency Resonant Acoustic Emission Cleave Sensor C [kHz] Range: 10.0 .. 500.0 *)
    rLinearEncoder_um       : LREAL;    (* Absolute Glass-Scale Optical Carriage Position [um] Range: -1000.0 .. 50000.0 *)
    rWheelSurfaceSpeed_mpmin: LREAL;    (* High-Resolution Magnetic Encoder on Scoring Diamond Spindle [m/min] *)
    rTargetMedianRatio      : LREAL;    (* Target Fracture Depth Ratio Relative to Ribbon Caliper [-] Nominal: 0.10 .. 0.18 *)
    bCycleTrigger           : BOOL;     (* Lehr Synchronization Scoring Cut Initiate Pulse [Rising Edge] *)
    bResetAcknowledge       : BOOL;     (* Operator Alarm & Diagnostic Acknowledge Pushbutton *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bSystemReady            : BOOL;     (* Subsystem Operational Ready Status for Supervisory Line PLC *)
    bScoringActive          : BOOL;     (* Closed-Loop Depth Actuation Engaged on Glass Substrate *)
    rActuatorControl_V      : LREAL;    (* Analog Command to Linear Voice-Coil Servodrive [V] Range: -10.0 .. +10.0 *)
    rEstimatedDepth_um      : LREAL;    (* State-Space Observer Estimated Median Vent Crack Penetration [um] *)
    rVotedForce_N           : LREAL;    (* Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Reconciled Downforce [N] *)
    rVotedAcousticEnergy_dB : LREAL;    (* Reconciled Acoustic Emission Wavefront Intensity [dB Ref 1uV] *)
    rWheelWearIndex_pct     : LREAL;    (* Real-Time Computed Diamond Matrix Abrasive Micro-Wear Index [%] *)
    dwDiagnosticsWord       : DWORD;    (* Comprehensive Diagnostic Telemetry and Fault Bitfield *)
    bGeneralAlarm           : BOOL;     (* Critical Severity Alarm Indicating Scoring Suspension *)
    bDegradedMode           : BOOL;     (* Subsystem Running in Graceful Degradation / 1oo2 Failover *)
    bCleaveQualityPass      : BOOL;     (* Real-time Acoustic Waveform Conformance to Optimal Median Cleave *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- Executive Sequencer State Machine --- *)
    iState                  : INT := 0;      (* Current Operational State Machine Index *)
    iPreviousState          : INT := -1;     (* Previous Step Index for Transition Tracking *)
    tStepTimer              : TON;           (* Multi-Purpose Diagnostic and Dwell Timer *)
    rCycleTime_s            : LREAL := 0.001;(* Execution Delta Time Ts = 1.0 ms *)

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) Evaluation Variables --- *)
    rForceDev_AB            : LREAL;         (* Load Cell Pairwise Absolute Error |ChA - ChB| [N] *)
    rForceDev_BC            : LREAL;         (* Load Cell Pairwise Absolute Error |ChB - ChC| [N] *)
    rForceDev_CA            : LREAL;         (* Load Cell Pairwise Absolute Error |ChC - ChA| [N] *)
    rForceTolThreshold_N    : LREAL := 12.5; (* Critical Discrepancy Boundary for TMR Invalidation [N] *)
    bChA_Valid_Force        : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Sensor ChA Integrity Health Bit *)
    bChB_Valid_Force        : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Sensor ChB Integrity Health Bit *)
    bChC_Valid_Force        : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Sensor ChC Integrity Health Bit *)
    iHealthyForceCount      : INT := 3;      (* Count of Fully Validated Force Transducers *)

    rAEDev_AB               : LREAL;         (* Acoustic Sensor Absolute Error |ChA - ChB| [kHz] *)
    rAEDev_BC               : LREAL;         (* Acoustic Sensor Absolute Error |ChB - ChC| [kHz] *)
    rAEDev_CA               : LREAL;         (* Acoustic Sensor Absolute Error |ChC - ChA| [kHz] *)
    rAETolThreshold_kHz     : LREAL := 28.0; (* Critical Discrepancy Boundary for Acoustic Sensors [kHz] *)
    bChA_Valid_AE           : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Acoustic ChA Health Bit *)
    bChB_Valid_AE           : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Acoustic ChB Health Bit *)
    bChC_Valid_AE           : BOOL := TRUE;  (* Acoustic ChC Health Bit *)
    iHealthyAECount         : INT := 3;      (* Count of Fully Validated Acoustic Emission Transducers *)

    (* --- State-Space Observer Model (Actuator + Tool Compliance Dynamics) --- *)
    (* State Vector x = [Position z [um], Velocity vz [um/s], Median Crack c [um]]^T *)
    x_hat_z                 : LREAL := 0.0;  (* Estimated Vertical Position [um] *)
    x_hat_vz                : LREAL := 0.0;  (* Estimated Vertical Penetration Velocity [um/s] *)
    x_hat_c                 : LREAL := 0.0;  (* Estimated Median Crack Vent Depth [um] *)

    (* Continuous to Discrete Model Parameters (Ts = 0.001 s) *)
    A_11                    : LREAL := 0.9852;
    A_12                    : LREAL := 0.00095;
    A_13                    : LREAL := 0.0000;
    A_21                    : LREAL := -28.450;
    A_22                    : LREAL := 0.9015;
    A_23                    : LREAL := -0.0125;
    A_31                    : LREAL := 0.0850;
    A_32                    : LREAL := 0.0012;
    A_33                    : LREAL := 0.9650;

    B_1                     : LREAL := 0.4200;  (* Input Matrix Component for Voice Coil Voltage [um/V] *)
    B_2                     : LREAL := 825.40;  (* Input Matrix Component for Voice Coil Acceleration [(um/s)/V] *)
    B_3                     : LREAL := 14.80;   (* Dynamic Crack Growth Gain [(um)/V] *)

    (* Steady-State Kalman Filter Observer Gains L *)
    L_11                    : LREAL := 0.3850;  (* Position Innovation Gain to Position *)
    L_21                    : LREAL := 142.60;  (* Position Innovation Gain to Velocity *)
    L_31                    : LREAL := 0.6500;  (* Position Innovation Gain to Crack Depth *)
    L_12                    : LREAL := 0.0025;  (* Force Innovation Gain to Position *)
    L_22                    : LREAL := 0.9800;  (* Force Innovation Gain to Velocity *)
    L_32                    : LREAL := 0.0480;  (* Force Innovation Gain to Crack Depth *)

    (* Model Predictive Control (MPC) Receding Horizon Variables *)
    rTargetCrackDepth_um    : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Dynamic Reference Trajectory for Crack Depth [um] *)
    rTargetForce_N          : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Optimal Normal Force Target Derived via LEFM [N] *)
    rMPC_PredictedErr_z     : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Predicted Displacement Tracking Deviation *)
    rMPC_PredictedErr_F     : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Predicted Force Tracking Deviation *)
    rK_mpc_p                : LREAL := 0.042; (* MPC State Weighting on Crack Depth *)
    rK_mpc_v                : LREAL := 0.0018;(* MPC Damping Weighting on Velocity *)
    rK_mpc_f                : LREAL := 0.038; (* MPC Normal Force Decoupling Gain *)
    rDeltaU                 : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Computed Incremental Actuation Voltage *)
    rActuatorUnconstrained_V: LREAL := 0.0;   (* Raw Voltage before Anti-Windup Saturation *)

    (* Griffith-Irwin Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM) Adaptation *)
    rK1C_Ambient            : LREAL := 0.750; (* Base Fracture Toughness of Soda-Lime Glass [MPa*m^0.5] *)
    rK1C_Corrected          : LREAL := 0.750; (* Thermally Compensated Fracture Toughness *)
    rThermalExpansionCoeff  : LREAL := 0.00085; (* Temperature Degradation Sensitivity [1/deg C] *)
    rCalculatedCompliance   : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Apparent Contact Compliance [um/N] *)

    (* Kinematic Wheel Slip and Tribological Wear Integration *)
    rWheelSlipRatio         : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Differential Kinematic Ratio between Glass & Wheel *)
    rSlipTolerance          : LREAL := 0.045; (* 4.5% Maximum Permissible Kinematic Slip *)
    rWearIntegralAccumulator: LREAL := 0.0;   (* Archard Abrasive Wear Metric Summation *)
    rWearScalingConstant    : LREAL := 1.25E-8; (* Tribological Calibration Factor *)

    (* Acoustic Cleave Frequency Spectrum Analysis *)
    rAcousticBand_Low_kHz   : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Low Frequency Micro-Crushing Power (20-60 kHz) *)
    rAcousticBand_Med_kHz   : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Optimal Median Crack Formation Band (120-220 kHz) *)
    rAcousticBand_High_kHz  : LREAL := 0.0;   (* High Frequency Splintering Noise (> 250 kHz) *)

    (* Internal Safety and Ramp Registers *)
    rTouchdownRampRate_Nps  : LREAL := 150.0; (* Normal Force Engagement Rate [N/s] *)
    rCurrentRampedForce_N   : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Dynamic Setpoint during Engagement *)
    bTouchdownDetected      : BOOL := FALSE;  (* First Surface Contact Flag *)
    rSurfaceReference_um    : LREAL := 0.0;   (* Zero-Datum Contact Coordinate [um] *)
    rMaxActuatorVoltage_V   : LREAL := 10.0;  (* Voice-Coil Saturation Boundary [V] *)
    rMinActuatorVoltage_V   : LREAL := -10.0; (* Voice-Coil Retraction Boundary [V] *)
END_VAR

(* =========================================================================================
   CRITICAL EMERGENCY INTERLOCK AND SAFETY PRE-EVALUATION
   ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* Immediate Fail-Safe De-energization: Drive retracted at maximum safe reverse slew *)
    rActuatorControl_V      := rMinActuatorVoltage_V;
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bScoringActive          := FALSE;
    bGeneralAlarm           := TRUE;
    bCleaveQualityPass      := FALSE;
    dwDiagnosticsWord       := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardwired E-Stop Tripped *)
    iState                  := 99; (* Transition to Safe Lockout Retract State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF NOT bEnable THEN
    (* Controlled Soft Standby: Retract tool to parking datum, reset active controls *)
    rActuatorControl_V      := -2.0; (* Moderate bias holding carriage against top buffer *)
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bScoringActive          := FALSE;
    bCleaveQualityPass      := FALSE;
    iState                  := 0;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Clear transient acknowledgeable flags if reset button commanded *)
IF bResetAcknowledge THEN
    dwDiagnosticsWord       := dwDiagnosticsWord AND 16#FFFF_0000;
    bGeneralAlarm           := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* =========================================================================================
   TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) FORCE VOTING ALGORITHM WITH SENSOR DRIFT ISOLATION
   ========================================================================================= *)
rForceDev_AB := ABS(rNormalForce_ChA_N - rNormalForce_ChB_N);
rForceDev_BC := ABS(rNormalForce_ChB_N - rNormalForce_ChC_N);
rForceDev_CA := ABS(rNormalForce_ChC_N - rNormalForce_ChA_N);

bChA_Valid_Force := TRUE;
bChB_Valid_Force := TRUE;
bChC_Valid_Force := TRUE;

IF (rForceDev_AB > rForceTolThreshold_N) AND (rForceDev_CA > rForceTolThreshold_N) THEN
    (* Channel A is inconsistent with both B and C -> Channel A isolated *)
    bChA_Valid_Force := FALSE;
ELSIF (rForceDev_AB > rForceTolThreshold_N) AND (rForceDev_BC > rForceTolThreshold_N) THEN
    (* Channel B is inconsistent with both A and C -> Channel B isolated *)
    bChB_Valid_Force := FALSE;
ELSIF (rForceDev_BC > rForceTolThreshold_N) AND (rForceDev_CA > rForceTolThreshold_N) THEN
    (* Channel C is inconsistent with both A and B -> Channel C isolated *)
    bChC_Valid_Force := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate healthy transducer quorum *)
iHealthyForceCount := BOOL_TO_INT(bChA_Valid_Force) + BOOL_TO_INT(bChB_Valid_Force) + BOOL_TO_INT(bChC_Valid_Force);

CASE iHealthyForceCount OF
    3:
        (* Pristine 2oo3 Median Selection *)
        IF (rNormalForce_ChA_N >= rNormalForce_ChB_N AND rNormalForce_ChA_N <= rNormalForce_ChC_N) OR
           (rNormalForce_ChA_N <= rNormalForce_ChB_N AND rNormalForce_ChA_N >= rNormalForce_ChC_N) THEN
            rVotedForce_N := rNormalForce_ChA_N;
        ELSIF (rNormalForce_ChB_N >= rNormalForce_ChA_N AND rNormalForce_ChB_N <= rNormalForce_ChC_N) OR
              (rNormalForce_ChB_N <= rNormalForce_ChA_N AND rNormalForce_ChB_N >= rNormalForce_ChC_N) THEN
            rVotedForce_N := rNormalForce_ChB_N;
        ELSE
            rVotedForce_N := rNormalForce_ChC_N;
        END_IF;
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0008; (* Clear Force Degraded *)
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0010; (* Clear Force Fatal Trip *)

    2:
        (* Graceful Degradation to 1oo2 Dual Averaging *)
        IF NOT bChA_Valid_Force THEN
            rVotedForce_N := (rNormalForce_ChB_N + rNormalForce_ChC_N) * 0.5;
            dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Force TMR Degraded (ChA Lost) *)
        ELSIF NOT bChB_Valid_Force THEN
            rVotedForce_N := (rNormalForce_ChA_N + rNormalForce_ChC_N) * 0.5;
            dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Force TMR Degraded (ChB Lost) *)
        ELSE
            rVotedForce_N := (rNormalForce_ChA_N + rNormalForce_ChB_N) * 0.5;
            dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Bit 3: Force TMR Degraded (ChC Lost) *)
        END_IF;
        bDegradedMode := TRUE;

    ELSE
        (* Total Loss of Force Sensing Integrity (0oo3 or severe split) -> Trip System *)
        rVotedForce_N := 0.0;
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Bit 4: Unrecoverable Force TMR Fault *)
        bGeneralAlarm := TRUE;
        iState := 99; (* Safe Abort *)
END_CASE;

(* =========================================================================================
   TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) ACOUSTIC EMISSION VOTING ALGORITHM
   ========================================================================================= *)
rAEDev_AB := ABS(rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz - rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz);
rAEDev_BC := ABS(rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz - rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz);
rAEDev_CA := ABS(rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz - rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz);

bChA_Valid_AE := TRUE;
bChB_Valid_AE := TRUE;
bChC_Valid_AE := TRUE;

IF (rAEDev_AB > rAETolThreshold_kHz) AND (rAEDev_CA > rAETolThreshold_kHz) THEN
    bChA_Valid_AE := FALSE;
ELSIF (rAEDev_AB > rAETolThreshold_kHz) AND (rAEDev_BC > rAETolThreshold_kHz) THEN
    bChB_Valid_AE := FALSE;
ELSIF (rAEDev_BC > rAETolThreshold_kHz) AND (rAEDev_CA > rAETolThreshold_kHz) THEN
    bChC_Valid_AE := FALSE;
END_IF;

iHealthyAECount := BOOL_TO_INT(bChA_Valid_AE) + BOOL_TO_INT(bChB_Valid_AE) + BOOL_TO_INT(bChC_Valid_AE);

CASE iHealthyAECount OF
    3:
        IF (rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz >= rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz AND rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz <= rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz) OR
           (rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz <= rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz AND rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz >= rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz) THEN
            rAcousticBand_Med_kHz := rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz;
        ELSIF (rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz >= rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz AND rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz <= rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz) OR
              (rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz <= rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz AND rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz >= rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz) THEN
            rAcousticBand_Med_kHz := rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz;
        ELSE
            rAcousticBand_Med_kHz := rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz;
        END_IF;
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0020; (* Clear AE Degraded *)
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0040; (* Clear AE Fatal *)

    2:
        IF NOT bChA_Valid_AE THEN
            rAcousticBand_Med_kHz := (rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz + rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz) * 0.5;
        ELSIF NOT bChB_Valid_AE THEN
            rAcousticBand_Med_kHz := (rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz + rAcousticEmission_ChC_kHz) * 0.5;
        ELSE
            rAcousticBand_Med_kHz := (rAcousticEmission_ChA_kHz + rAcousticEmission_ChB_kHz) * 0.5;
        END_IF;
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Bit 5: AE TMR Degraded *)
        bDegradedMode := TRUE;

    ELSE
        rAcousticBand_Med_kHz := 0.0;
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Bit 6: Fatal AE TMR Sensor Loss *)
        bGeneralAlarm := TRUE;
END_CASE;

(* Synthesize Logarithmic Acoustic Energy from dominant resonance *)
IF rAcousticBand_Med_kHz > 1.0 THEN
    rVotedAcousticEnergy_dB := 20.0 * (LN(rAcousticBand_Med_kHz * 0.1) / 2.302585);
ELSE
    rVotedAcousticEnergy_dB := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* =========================================================================================
   GRIFFITH-IRWIN LINEAR ELASTIC FRACTURE MECHANICS (LEFM) MODEL
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Temperature dependence of critical fracture toughness K1C for Soda-Lime Silicate *)
IF (rGlassTemp_degC >= 20.0) AND (rGlassTemp_degC <= 180.0) THEN
    rK1C_Corrected := rK1C_Ambient * (1.0 - (rThermalExpansionCoeff * (rGlassTemp_degC - 20.0)));
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0004; (* Clear Temp Out of Range *)
ELSE
    rK1C_Corrected := rK1C_Ambient;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Bit 2: Glass Temperature Out of Envelope *)
END_IF;

(* Bounded median vent crack target depth [um] *)
IF (rTargetMedianRatio >= 0.05) AND (rTargetMedianRatio <= 0.30) THEN
    rTargetCrackDepth_um := rGlassThickness_um * rTargetMedianRatio;
ELSE
    rTargetCrackDepth_um := rGlassThickness_um * 0.125; (* Safe default 12.5% thickness penetration *)
END_IF;

(* Optimal contact normal force calculated from Lawn-Evans equilibrium median crack relation:
   c = alpha * (P / K_1C)^(2/3)  =>  P_target = K_1C * (c / alpha)^(3/2) *)
rTargetForce_N := (rK1C_Corrected * 1.45) * EXPT(MAX(rTargetCrackDepth_um * 0.015, 0.01), 1.5);
IF rTargetForce_N > 320.0 THEN
    rTargetForce_N := 320.0; (* Strict physical clamp to avoid shattering ribbon *)
ELSIF rTargetForce_N < 25.0 THEN
    rTargetForce_N := 25.0;  (* Minimum force to guarantee diamond penetration *)
END_IF;

(* =========================================================================================
   KINEMATIC SCORING WHEEL SLIP AND ABRASIVE WEAR INTEGRATION
   ========================================================================================= *)
IF rRibbonSpeed_mpmin > 1.0 THEN
    rWheelSlipRatio := ABS(rWheelSurfaceSpeed_mpmin - rRibbonSpeed_mpmin) / rRibbonSpeed_mpmin;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0002; (* Clear Ribbon Low Speed *)
ELSE
    rWheelSlipRatio := 0.0;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Ribbon Speed Low Alarm *)
END_IF;

IF rWheelSlipRatio > rSlipTolerance THEN
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Bit 7: Excessive Wheel Slip / Dragging *)
ELSE
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0080;
END_IF;

(* Archard Diamond Wear Equation Accumulator: dW = k_wear * F_normal * v_line * (1 + 2*Slip) * dt *)
IF bScoringActive AND (rVotedForce_N > 5.0) THEN
    rWearIntegralAccumulator := rWearIntegralAccumulator +
        (rWearScalingConstant * rVotedForce_N * (rRibbonSpeed_mpmin / 60.0) * (1.0 + (2.0 * rWheelSlipRatio)) * rCycleTime_s);
    rWheelWearIndex_pct := MIN(100.0, (rWearIntegralAccumulator * 1000.0));
    IF rWheelWearIndex_pct >= 90.0 THEN
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Diamond Wheel Wear Limit Exceeded *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* =========================================================================================
   DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (KALMAN ESTIMATION OF PENETRATION & CRACK DEPTH)
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Prediction Phase *)
x_hat_z  := (A_11 * x_hat_z)  + (A_12 * x_hat_vz) + (A_13 * x_hat_c) + (B_1 * rActuatorControl_V);
x_hat_vz := (A_21 * x_hat_z)  + (A_22 * x_hat_vz) + (A_23 * x_hat_c) + (B_2 * rActuatorControl_V);
x_hat_c  := (A_31 * x_hat_z)  + (A_32 * x_hat_vz) + (A_33 * x_hat_c) + (B_3 * rActuatorControl_V);

(* Measurement Correction Phase using Linear Encoder and 2oo3 Normal Force Feedback *)
x_hat_z  := x_hat_z  + (L_11 * (rLinearEncoder_um - x_hat_z)) + (L_12 * (rVotedForce_N - (x_hat_c * 0.45)));
x_hat_vz := x_hat_vz + (L_21 * (rLinearEncoder_um - x_hat_z)) + (L_22 * (rVotedForce_N - (x_hat_c * 0.45)));
x_hat_c  := x_hat_c  + (L_31 * (rLinearEncoder_um - x_hat_z)) + (L_32 * (rVotedForce_N - (x_hat_c * 0.45)));

rEstimatedDepth_um := MAX(0.0, x_hat_c);

(* =========================================================================================
   MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) WITH REFINED MPC CONTROL
   ========================================================================================= *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* --- STATE 0: INITIALIZATION, SELF-DIAGNOSTICS & PARKING CALIBRATION --- *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bScoringActive          := FALSE;
        bCleaveQualityPass      := FALSE;
        rActuatorControl_V      := -2.5; (* Retract to upper mechanical soft stop *)
        bTouchdownDetected      := FALSE;
        rCurrentRampedForce_N   := 0.0;
        tStepTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#500MS);

        IF (iHealthyForceCount >= 2) AND (iHealthyAECount >= 2) AND (NOT bGeneralAlarm) THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#500MS);
            IF tStepTimer.Q THEN
                tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 10;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* --- STATE 10: TMR SENSOR VALIDATION & ZERO-DATUM REGISTRATION --- *)
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        rActuatorControl_V  := 0.0; (* Float actuator over glass surface *)
        tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#250MS);

        IF tStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            (* Verify ribbon line speed is synchronized *)
            IF (rRibbonSpeed_mpmin >= 2.0) AND (rRibbonSpeed_mpmin <= 32.0) THEN
                bSystemReady := TRUE;
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Standby Waiting *)
            ELSE
                dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0002;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* --- STATE 20: SYNCHRONIZATION AND STANDBY WAITING --- *)
        bSystemReady        := TRUE;
        bScoringActive      := FALSE;
        rActuatorControl_V  := 0.5; (* Bias down close to lehr glass pass-line *)

        IF bCycleTrigger THEN
            bSystemReady        := FALSE;
            bTouchdownDetected  := FALSE;
            rSurfaceReference_um:= rLinearEncoder_um;
            rCurrentRampedForce_N := 5.0; (* Pre-load touchdown trigger setpoint *)
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    30: (* --- STATE 30: CONTROLLED VELOCITY TOUCHDOWN & FORCE RAMP --- *)
        bScoringActive := TRUE;

        IF NOT bTouchdownDetected THEN
            (* Descend slowly at constant 0.8 V until load cells sense 6.0 N contact *)
            rActuatorControl_V := 1.25;
            IF rVotedForce_N >= 6.0 THEN
                bTouchdownDetected   := TRUE;
                rSurfaceReference_um := rLinearEncoder_um;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* Ramp normal force deterministically to avoid impact chipping *)
            rCurrentRampedForce_N := rCurrentRampedForce_N + (rTouchdownRampRate_Nps * rCycleTime_s);
            IF rCurrentRampedForce_N >= rTargetForce_N THEN
                rCurrentRampedForce_N := rTargetForce_N;
                iState := 40; (* Handover to Closed-Loop MPC Controller *)
            END_IF;
            (* Baseline proportional force servo during ramp *)
            rActuatorControl_V := 1.5 + ((rCurrentRampedForce_N - rVotedForce_N) * 0.035);
        END_IF;

    40: (* --- STATE 40: CLOSED-LOOP MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) SCORING --- *)
        bScoringActive := TRUE;

        (* Compute dynamic control deviation vectors *)
        rMPC_PredictedErr_z := (rTargetCrackDepth_um - rEstimatedDepth_um);
        rMPC_PredictedErr_F := (rTargetForce_N - rVotedForce_N);

        (* Receding Horizon Linear Quadratic Synthesis:
           DeltaU = K_p * (c_target - c_est) - K_v * v_z + K_f * (F_target - F_voted) *)
        rDeltaU := (rK_mpc_p * rMPC_PredictedErr_z)
                 - (rK_mpc_v * x_hat_vz)
                 + (rK_mpc_f * rMPC_PredictedErr_F);

        (* Integral accumulation with anti-windup bounding *)
        rActuatorUnconstrained_V := rActuatorControl_V + rDeltaU;
        IF rActuatorUnconstrained_V > rMaxActuatorVoltage_V THEN
            rActuatorControl_V := rMaxActuatorVoltage_V;
            dwDiagnosticsWord  := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_4000; (* Bit 14: Actuator Saturated High *)
        ELSIF rActuatorUnconstrained_V < rMinActuatorVoltage_V THEN
            rActuatorControl_V := rMinActuatorVoltage_V;
            dwDiagnosticsWord  := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_4000; (* Bit 14: Actuator Saturated Low *)
        ELSE
            rActuatorControl_V := rActuatorUnconstrained_V;
            dwDiagnosticsWord  := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_4000;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for lateral micro-cracking overforce violation *)
        IF rVotedForce_N > (rTargetForce_N * 1.45) THEN
            dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Bit 8: Overforce Lateral Warning *)
            rActuatorControl_V := rActuatorControl_V - 0.75; (* Instantaneous force shedding *)
        ELSE
            dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0100;
        END_IF;

        (* Transition to Acoustic Cleave Evaluation once stabilized *)
        iState := 50;

    50: (* --- STATE 50: ACOUSTIC EMISSION CLEAVE VERIFICATION & TRIMMING --- *)
        bScoringActive := TRUE;

        (* Verify that acoustic energy is dominated by the optimal median vent frequency (120-220 kHz) *)
        IF (rAcousticBand_Med_kHz >= 120.0) AND (rAcousticBand_Med_kHz <= 220.0) AND (rVotedAcousticEnergy_dB >= 42.0) THEN
            bCleaveQualityPass := TRUE;
            dwDiagnosticsWord  := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0200; (* Clear Low Energy *)
            dwDiagnosticsWord  := dwDiagnosticsWord AND NOT 16#0000_0400; (* Clear Crush Noise *)
        ELSIF (rVotedAcousticEnergy_dB < 35.0) THEN
            (* Shallow score / skipping detected *)
            bCleaveQualityPass := FALSE;
            dwDiagnosticsWord  := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Bit 9: Acoustic Cleave Energy Low *)
            rActuatorControl_V := rActuatorControl_V + 0.15; (* Micro-nudge normal force upward *)
        ELSIF (rAcousticBand_Med_kHz < 80.0) AND (rVotedAcousticEnergy_dB > 68.0) THEN
            (* Low frequency acoustic roar indicates glass crushing and subsurface splintering *)
            bCleaveQualityPass := FALSE;
            dwDiagnosticsWord  := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: Splintering / Crushing Alarm *)
            rActuatorControl_V := rActuatorControl_V - 0.35; (* Immediate load reduction *)
        END_IF;

        (* Maintain closed loop or trigger retraction upon cycle completion *)
        IF NOT bCycleTrigger THEN
            iState := 60; (* Score cut stroke finished -> Controlled Retract *)
        ELSE
            iState := 40; (* Continue MPC tracking *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* --- STATE 60: CONTROLLED RETRACT AND POST-SCORE AUDIT --- *)
        bScoringActive     := FALSE;
        bCleaveQualityPass := FALSE;
        rActuatorControl_V := -5.0; (* High-speed retract to safe transit clearance *)
        tStepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#150MS);

        IF tStepTimer.Q THEN
            tStepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 0; (* Cycle completed successfully, return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* --- STATE 80: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION OPERATING REGIME --- *)
        (* Engaged when 1 of 3 load cells or acoustic transducers fails *)
        bDegradedMode := TRUE;
        dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_8000; (* Bit 15: Graceful Degradation Active *)

        (* Limit peak forces and line speed permissives to preserve line uptime *)
        IF rTargetForce_N > 210.0 THEN
            rTargetForce_N := 210.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Re-route back to operational MPC if 2oo3 failover maintains 2 healthy sensors *)
        IF (iHealthyForceCount >= 2) AND (iHealthyAECount >= 2) THEN
            iState := 40;
        ELSE
            iState := 99; (* Degraded below safe thresholds -> Trip *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* --- STATE 99: CRITICAL EMERGENCY SAFE RETRACT AND LOCKOUT --- *)
        bSystemReady       := FALSE;
        bScoringActive     := FALSE;
        bCleaveQualityPass := FALSE;
        bGeneralAlarm      := TRUE;
        rActuatorControl_V := rMinActuatorVoltage_V; (* Maximum negative voice-coil force upward *)

        (* Hold indefinitely until reset pushbutton pressed while E-Stop and Quorum restored *)
        IF bResetAcknowledge AND bEmergencyStop AND (iHealthyForceCount >= 2) THEN
            bGeneralAlarm := FALSE;
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
